theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_kernel_term_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (u q : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (σ ρ R A C : ℝ) (k : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < σ → ρ ≤ R → AEStronglyMeasurable u (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → AEStronglyMeasurable q (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |u x| ≤ A ∧ |q x| ≤ 1) → (∀ m, Measurable (k m)) → (∀ m s, 0 ≤ s → |k m s| ≤ C) → (∀ m s, R < s → k m s = 0) → (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → Tendsto (fun m ↦ k m s) atTop (𝓝 ((Ioc σ ρ).indicator (fun s ↦ (s ^ n)⁻¹) s))) → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ u x * (q x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n)) (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ ∧ Tendsto (fun m ↦ ∫ x, u x * q x * k m ‖x - ξ‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ, u x * (q x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n) ∂μ))
